Sudden stomach upset and pancreatitis (pancreas inflammation) are common reasons dogs visit the veterinary hospital. For a smooth recovery and to prevent flare-ups, a gentle, low-fat diet is essential.


We are evaluating a new, fresh, fully cooked, low-fat diet to see how well dogs accept the diet and to determine how well the diet acts as an at-home recovery aid after a digestive flare-up or bout of pancreatitis.

The Mars Petcare Biobank aims to follow thousands of cats and dogs throughout their lives and understand how pets can stay healthy for longer. Like in human medicine, \u201cone-size-fits-all\u201d healthcare solutions don\u2019t always work for every pet. The pets in this study will help scientists analyze what triggers pets\u2019 illness, so they can spot it before it strikes. Scientists will also learn how cats and dogs eat, sleep, play, and behave throughout all stages of their lives. These insights can help our teams across Mars improve preventive care.
